hypotheses.title: Options Variance Risk Premium (VRP) Subindustry Cauchy Reversion
hypotheses.economic_rationale: The ratio of implied volatility to historical realized volatility (implied_volatility_call_30 / (historical_volatility_30 + 0.001)) measures the variance risk premium demanded by option market makers. Being strictly positive (X > 0) with 98% matrix coverage in TOP3000, benchmarking against subindustry peers and applying 60-day Cauchy dispersion isolates unsustainable hedging panic that mean-reverts as implied volatility crushes, providing strong counter-balancing portfolio diversification against equity price/volume wicks.
confounders: Impending binary litigation or merger outcomes that validate elevated implied volatility
Regime shifts in macro interest rates
hypotheses.falsification_test: Underperforms during sustained market crashes where elevated implied volatility correctly predicts accelerating forward realized volatility across consecutive quarters.

candidates.expression: vrp = implied_volatility_call_30 / (historical_volatility_30 + 0.001); mean_vrp = group_mean(vrp, rank(ts_mean(cap, 60)), subindustry); disp = abs(vrp - mean_vrp) / (abs(vrp) + abs(mean_vrp) + 0.05); disp_smooth = ts_mean(disp, 60); vrp_std = ts_std_dev(vrp, 60); adj_vrp = disp_smooth * vrp_std * vrp; adj_mean = ts_mean(adj_vrp, 60); adj_std = ts_std_dev(adj_vrp, 60); bonus = zscore(adj_mean) + zscore(adj_std); signal = -quantile(bonus, driver="cauchy"); ts_decay_linear(signal, 60)

hypotheses.title: Systematic Beta Dislocation Subindustry Cauchy Reversion
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Short-term beta expanding rapidly relative to 1-year baseline (abs(beta_last_60_days_spy / (beta_last_360_days_spy + 0.05) - 1.0)) indicates speculative retail crowding or temporary liquidity dislocation. Being strictly non-negative (X >= 0) and derived from rolling SPY regressions (98% matrix coverage), benchmarking against subindustry peers and compressing fat tails with Cauchy quantiles extracts robust idiosyncratic beta mean-reversion with low turnover and zero correlation to cash equity wicks.
confounders: Permanent business model transformations that structurally shift firm systematic beta
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during market crisis transitions where high-beta drift persists indefinitely without reverting to historical norms.

candidates.expression: rel_beta = beta_last_60_days_spy / (beta_last_360_days_spy + 0.05); abs_beta_drift = abs(rel_beta - 1.0); mean_drift = group_mean(abs_beta_drift, rank(ts_mean(cap, 60)), subindustry); disp = abs(abs_beta_drift - mean_drift) / (abs(abs_beta_drift) + abs(mean_drift) + 0.05); disp_smooth = ts_mean(disp, 60); drift_std = ts_std_dev(abs_beta_drift, 60); adj_drift = disp_smooth * drift_std * abs_beta_drift; adj_mean = ts_mean(adj_drift, 60); adj_std = ts_std_dev(adj_drift, 60); bonus = zscore(adj_mean) + zscore(adj_std); signal = -quantile(bonus, driver="cauchy"); ts_decay_linear(signal, 60)

hypotheses.title: Overnight Gap Shock Subindustry Reversion 120D
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Absolute overnight gap jumps (abs(open / ts_delay(close, 1) - 1)) capture off-hours information surprises. Benchmarking against subindustry peers instead of the entire market removes broad macro market noise and aligns with subindustry portfolio neutralization. Decaying over 120 days compresses turnover below 4% and extends Fitness, mirroring the exact transformation that elevated Volume Ratio to Fitness 3.02.
confounders: Unscheduled buyout bids with fixed cash acquisition price
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during momentum-driven earnings drift where gap magnitude signals sustained multi-quarter fundamental revaluation.

candidates.expression: gap = abs(open / ts_delay(close, 1) - 1); mean_gap = group_mean(gap, rank(ts_mean(cap, 60)), subindustry); disp = abs(gap - mean_gap) / (abs(gap) + abs(mean_gap) + 0.05); disp_smooth = ts_mean(disp, 120); gap_std = ts_std_dev(gap, 120); adj_gap = disp_smooth * gap_std * gap; adj_mean = ts_mean(adj_gap, 120); adj_std = ts_std_dev(adj_gap, 120); bonus = zscore(adj_mean) + zscore(adj_std); signal = -quantile(bonus, driver="cauchy"); ts_decay_linear(signal, 120)
